description: costas_loop_cc order 4 on QPSK with a frequency and phase offset

fixed_vs_float.rationale: The NCO is a sine table of 2^lut_bits entries: a phase error of up to pi / 2^lut_bits rad per sample (7.7e-4 for 12 bits, 1.9e-4 for 14), which the loop turns into the output and error differences; the frequency estimate averages it (loop bandwidth 0.03-0.04).

The NCO is a sine table of 2^lut_bits entries: a phase error of up to pi / 2^lut_bits rad per sample (7.7e-4 for 12 bits, 1.9e-4 for 14), which the loop turns into the output and error differences; the frequency estimate averages it (loop bandwidth 0.03-0.04).

float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: One recurrence in f32 on both sides; GNU Radio uses sincosf and f32 products, differences stay at a few 1e-7 (measured 2e-6 at most) and the loop does not amplify them.
